hero.title: Hi, I’m Ekki
hero.subtitle: I’m a QA/SDET, mentor, and the person behind TestingWithEkki.
hero.description: I built TWE to share practical learning for QA engineers who want to understand the systems they test, not only the tools they use.

why.title: Why I built TestingWithEkki
why.quote: My career was shaped by great mentors. TestingWithEkki is my way of paying it forward by creating a practical place for QA engineers to grow technically.
why.paragraph1: A lot of what helped me grow came from having people around me who explained the reasoning behind the work, gave me room to try things myself, and helped when I got stuck.
why.paragraph2: I want TWE to provide more of that kind of learning environment.

background.title: A bit about my background
background.paragraph1: I started as a developer and moved deeper into QA engineering and SDET work. My experience spans web and API automation, integration-heavy systems, microservices, event-driven testing, CI/CD, and test infrastructure.
background.paragraph2: Over time, I also found myself spending more time building frameworks, helping other testers automate, and mentoring people who wanted to become more technical.

contact.title: Want to talk?
contact.description: For mentoring, partnerships, sponsorships, or anything else related to TWE.
